description: This source file defines the 'GatewayOnboardingView' along with its subviews 'AutoDetectStep' and 'ManualEntryStep', which provide a user interface for connecting to a gateway via auto-detection or manual entry. The file is part of an onboarding flow for a gateway device in an iOS app.

classes.name: GatewayOnboardingView
classes.description: Main view for onboarding and connecting to a gateway, providing options for auto-detection and manual entry.

classes.name: ManualEntryStep
classes.description: View handling manual connection process including setup code parsing and user input for host, port, token, and password.

classes.name: ConnectionStatusBox
classes.description: View displaying connection status lines with optional secondary information.

methods.name: triggerAutoConnect
methods.description: Initiates an automatic connection attempt if a suitable gateway candidate is found.

methods.name: autoCandidate
methods.description: Selects the preferred gateway candidate based on user settings or fallback logic.

methods.name: connectManual
methods.description: Attempts to connect to a gateway using manual input parameters.

methods.name: manualPortValue
methods.description: Parses and returns the port number from user input.

methods.name: applySetupCode
methods.description: Decodes and applies a setup code, updating host, port, TLS, token, and password states.

methods.name: applyURL
methods.description: Parses URL from setup code and updates relevant fields.
